case_title.quote: DEEPAK GULATI v. STATE OF HARYANA

number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant Deepak Gulati was tried.

accused_gender.quote: the appellant had sexual intercourse with her

accused_age.reason: The accused's age is never given in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of the accused is not stated.

accused_occupation.correct_value: Not clearly stated; PW10 mentions an engineering student named Ashwini, not the accused
accused_occupation.reason: Occupation is not stated, so 'Not stated' is essentially right.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Acquaintance/known to each other; romantic relationship with promise of marriage
accused_victim_relationship.quote: The appellant and Geeta, prosecutrix, 19 years of age... had known each other for some time.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: They knew each other; she was inclined towards him, so not strangers.

offence_category.quote: convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 365 and 376
offence_category.reason: Rape is right, but s.365 abduction/confinement charge is omitted.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 365 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code
statutory_provisions.reason: Charged and convicted sections correctly listed.

evidence_type.correct_value: Testimony of prosecutrix, father, warden, ASI; medical evidence; school register for age; no recovery
evidence_type.quote: Dr. (Mrs.) Amarjeet Wadhwa (PW.11)... examined the prosecutrix
evidence_type.reason: Medical and witness testimony present, but no recovery evidence is mentioned.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances relating to sentence stated.

trial_court_outcome.quote: the Sessions Court convicted the appellant under Sections 365/376 IPC

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence affirmed
high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court has affirmed the judgment and order of the Additional Sessions Judge
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court did decide and affirmed conviction; not 'Not applicable'.

final_outcome.quote: the appeal succeeds and is allowed. His conviction and sentences... are set aside.

offence_finally_established.quote: His conviction and sentences awarded by the courts below are set aside.

imprisonment_type.quote: His conviction and sentences awarded by the courts below are set aside.

imprisonment_years.quote: conviction and sentences awarded by the courts below are set aside

fine_rs.quote: conviction and sentences awarded by the courts below are set aside

neutral_facts.correct_value: Should state facts as alleged without conclusions; omit court's finding on consent and Supreme Court reasoning
neutral_facts.quote: the appellant had been unable to reach the pre-decided place
neutral_facts.reason: States prosecution allegations as fact and reveals the court's finding on consent, leaking the outcome.

offence_severity.correct_value: 3 years (s.365) and 7 years (s.376) rigorous imprisonment imposed by trial court
offence_severity.quote: rigorous imprisonment for a period of three years... seven years
offence_severity.reason: Range roughly matches imposed sentences, though phrasing is loose.

physical_harm.correct_value: Alleged sexual intercourse; no injury noted
physical_harm.quote: the prosecutrix had indulged in sexual intercourse and was habitual to the same
physical_harm.reason: 'Rape' is a legal label, not physical harm; no injuries recorded.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 2 offences charged, 0 upheld by Supreme Court
number_of_offences.quote: His conviction and sentences awarded by the courts below are set aside.
number_of_offences.reason: Both convictions were set aside, so none upheld.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Court found no evidence of mala fide intention from the start
premeditation_planning.quote: no evidence to prove conclusively, that the appellant had never intended to marry
premeditation_planning.reason: 'Not found' is roughly right but the judgment addresses it only indirectly.

motive.correct_value: Prosecution alleged intent to satisfy lust under false promise of marriage; not established
motive.quote: had made a false promise to this effect only to satisfy his lust
motive.reason: Alleged motive discussed, though not established.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the prosecutrix had left her home voluntarily, of her own free will to get married

witness_credibility.quote: There exist in the statements of the witnesses material contradictions, improvements and embellishments.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Appellant met prosecutrix again at Birla Mandir and proceeded with her toward Ambala to marry; apprehended at bus stand
post_offence_conduct.quote: she even proceeded with the appellant to the old bus-stand in Kurukshetra
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment does describe post-incident conduct.

custody_duration.correct_value: Appellant had served more than 3 years of sentence
custody_duration.quote: the appellant, who has already served more than 3 years sentence

bail_history.quote: The appellant is on bail. His bail bonds stand discharged.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence 10.5.1995; trial judgment 13.11.1998; HC 28.01.2010; SC decision May 20, 2013
trial_duration.reason: SC decision date given as 28.05.2013 but judgment is dated May 20, 2013.

legal_representation.quote: Amit Pawan for the Appellant. Kamal Mohan Gupta for the Respondent.
legal_representation.reason: Matches counsel listed, though no one appeared for appellant at hearing.

investigation_status.quote: a chargesheet was filed against the appellant

appeal_history.quote: the High Court has affirmed the judgment... the appeal succeeds and is allowed.

prosecution_argument.quote: enticed the 19 year old daughter of PW8, wrongfully confined her

defence_argument.correct_value: Not stated; no one appeared for the appellant
defence_argument.reason: No defence arguments are recorded in the judgment.

legal_principle_applied.quote: There is a clear distinction between rape and consensual sex

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Uday v. State of Karnataka, AIR 2003 SC 1639; Deelip Singh

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: No sentencing rationale; conviction set aside as no false promise established
sentencing_rationale.quote: entitled to the benefit of doubt
sentencing_rationale.reason: Court gave no sentencing rationale; says 'lack of evidence' loosely.

judicial_mitigating_factors.correct_value: No mitigating factors for sentence; these facts led to acquittal
judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: the prosecutrix had left her home voluntarily
judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: These were grounds for acquittal, not mitigation.

other_sentence_order.reason: No other orders beyond setting aside and discharging bail bonds.
